questions.title: Most Federally-Owned Public Land
questions.current_disclaimer: Includes BLM, USFS, NPS, FWS, and DoD holdings; expressed as a percent of the state's total land area.

questions.title: Most Retail Sales per Capita
questions.current_disclaimer: Total retail sales divided by resident population; low-population, tourism-heavy states punch above their weight.

questions.title: States with the fewest neighbors
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts land borders only; states separated only by water are not counted as neighbors.

questions.title: States with the lowest point below sea level
questions.current_disclaimer: Ranked by depth below sea level; rank 1 is the deepest below sea level.

questions.title: States that touch a Great Lake
questions.current_disclaimer: Eight US states have a Great Lakes shoreline; the pool is exactly 8.

questions.title: States with the most active volcanoes
questions.current_disclaimer: Includes volcanoes classified by USGS as historically active or potentially active.

questions.title: States with the largest desert area
questions.current_disclaimer: Includes the Great Basin, Mojave, Sonoran, and Chihuahuan deserts.

questions.title: States with the largest wetlands area
questions.current_disclaimer: Includes all classes of wetlands per NWI: freshwater, estuarine, and marine.

questions.title: States with the most known caves
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts documented caves per NSS state surveys; includes both wild and show caves.

questions.title: States with the longest surveyed cave systems
questions.current_disclaimer: Ranked by the longest single surveyed cave system located in each state.

questions.title: States with the highest average elevation
questions.current_disclaimer: Mean elevation is measured across the entire state land area, so terrain distribution matters more than the highest peak alone.

questions.title: States with the most Mississippi watershed drainage
questions.current_disclaimer: Ranked by area of each state that drains to the Mississippi River (not total state area).

questions.title: Wettest States (Most Annual Precipitation)
questions.current_disclaimer: Statewide averages from NOAA 1991-2020 normals. Individual sites (e.g. Mount Waialeale) far exceed statewide means.

questions.title: Driest States (Least Annual Precipitation)
questions.current_disclaimer: Rank 1 is the driest state (lowest inches per year). Statewide averages, not local extremes.

questions.title: Most Tornadoes Per Year
questions.current_disclaimer: Based on NWS annual counts for 1991-2020. Includes all confirmed tornadoes regardless of EF rating.

questions.title: Most Hurricane Landfalls (1851-2020)
questions.current_disclaimer: Counts direct hurricane landfalls on each state's coast, per NOAA HURDAT2. A single storm crossing multiple states is counted once per state.

questions.title: Highest Recorded Temperature
questions.current_disclaimer: Highest all-time official temperature per NOAA's State Climate Extremes Committee. Death Valley's 134°F (1913) remains debated but is the accepted official record.

questions.title: Lowest Recorded Temperature
questions.current_disclaimer: Rank 1 is the coldest ever recorded (most negative Fahrenheit). All-time official state minima per NOAA SCEC.

questions.title: Most Sunshine Hours Per Year
questions.current_disclaimer: Statewide averages derived from NOAA/NWS first-order station normals. Some states are averaged across multiple reporting stations.

questions.title: Cloudiest States (Fewest Sunny Days)
questions.current_disclaimer: Rank 1 is the cloudiest state. Based on mean number of overcast days per NOAA/NWS station normals.
